scientific_integrity: Proof and reproducible finite checks are provided; no claim of independent verification or unqualified novelty.
scientific_limitations: The number of named metric distance levels is fixed and common to the compared structures.
The theorem is for regular finite ultrametrics with at least two children at every level and leaves only as elements.
Counting quantifiers distinguish branching profiles and are not covered by the ordinary noncounting equivalence.
Finite computational verification is corroboration, not proof of the arbitrary-height assertion.
Historical priority has not been exhaustively established, and independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact \(k\)-variable theories of finite homogeneous ultrametrics
